description: This file defines functions related to executing system commands within different contexts, including creating execution contexts for running commands as specific users and executing commands while capturing their output.

methods.name: NewAsUserExecContext
methods.description: Creates an execution context that, when invoked, runs commands as a specified user using 'sudo'.

methods.name: Exec
methods.description: Executes a command with a given execution context, capturing standard output and returning it, along with any errors encountered.
